name: Dispute
overview: Scripture instructs believers to handle disputes with gentleness and wisdom, emphasizing that a soft answer can defuse anger, while harsh words provoke it. In cases of personal offense, Matthew 18:15 teaches the importance of addressing the matter privately to restore relationships and gain a brother. Furthermore, Christians are called to refrain from personal vengeance, leaving judgment to God who executes righteous wrath. Civil authorities are recognized as ministers of God, carrying out justice on evildoers, underscoring the believer’s responsibility to trust God’s sovereign justice rather than taking matters into their own hands.
